info.title: TaskDesk API
info.description: TaskDesk Project Management API - Manage projects, tasks, labels, and more

idToken.description: The stored id_token for the user's `custom` OAuth account, or null when they have no such account.

dueDate.description: The soonest due date among the project's open tasks.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

metadata.description: Provider-specific payload, already parsed from the stored JSON string.

slug.description: Short prefix used in task identifiers, e.g. KAN-12.

archivedAt.description: Non-null once archived; archived projects are hidden by default.

deletedAt.description: Non-null once soft-deleted; deleted projects are excluded everywhere in ordinary use, independent of archivedAt.

purgeAfter.description: Non-null once soft-deleted: the point after which the project becomes eligible for purge. No purge job exists yet (#198).

lastTaskNumber.description: Highest task number issued in this project; the next task gets this plus one.

active.description: False once stood down (PR-12) -- never deleted, kept for history.

BoardPagination.description: When no page/limit is given, everything is returned on a single page.

status.description: The slug of the column the task sits in.

labels.description: Label names and colors, without their ids.

tasks.description: Per-task outcome, each carrying a success flag.

type.description: One of: comment, task, create, status_changed, priority_changed, assignee_changed, unassigned, due_date_changed, title_changed, description_changed.

content.description: Matched body text, for comment and activity results. Activities get a rendered summary such as `changed status from Todo to In Progress`.

version.description: The current row version, present only for task results.

relationType.description: How the two tasks relate: `subtask`, `blocks`, or `related`.

resourceType.description: The kind of remote resource, e.g. `issue` or `pull_request`.

get.description: Public liveness probe for the auth surface. Deliberately a constant shape (#18): it never reveals whether the instance has been claimed, so an unauthenticated caller cannot scan for an unclaimed instance to race for admin. First-run setup is reached through the one-time setup URL and token printed to the container log, not discovered from here.
Get the current authenticated session, or null when the caller is not signed in. Served by Better Auth.

200.description: Current session details, or null when unauthenticated

put.summary: Upload bytes to the filesystem storage driver
put.description: The local equivalent of a presigned S3 PUT: accepts raw bytes for a short-lived, key-scoped upload token minted by createTaskImageUploadUrl when TASKDESK_STORAGE_DRIVER is filesystem (the default). Not authenticated by a browser session — the signed token in the query string is the credential, the same way possession of a presigned S3 URL is. 404s when the s3 driver is active, since that driver never issues a URL pointing here.

400.description: Invalid key, expired or invalid token, or the upload exceeds the configured limit

404.description: The filesystem storage driver is not active

put.summary: Upload attachment bytes to the filesystem storage driver
put.description: The local equivalent of a presigned S3 PUT for an attachment, minted by POST /api/work-items/{key}/attachments/presign when TASKDESK_STORAGE_DRIVER is filesystem (the default). Not authenticated by a browser session -- the signed token in the query string, which also binds the exact size ceiling that was validated at presign time, is the credential.

400.description: Invalid key, expired or invalid token, or the upload exceeds the signed limit

404.description: The filesystem storage driver is not active

get.summary: Download attachment bytes from the filesystem storage driver
get.description: The local equivalent of a presigned S3 GET, minted by GET /api/attachments/{id} when TASKDESK_STORAGE_DRIVER is filesystem.

400.description: Invalid key, or expired or invalid token

404.description: The filesystem storage driver is not active, or the object is gone

get.description: Download a user avatar by its avatar ID. Public, immutable, and cache-friendly: the id changes whenever the avatar is replaced.
